References to “you,” “your,” or “Client” mean the individual or business entity using or subscribing to the Services, as applicable.

You may use Mochi as an individual or on behalf of a business entity or team.

By using Mochi, you represent and warrant that you have the legal authority to enter into these Terms and to bind any entity on whose behalf you are acting.

2. Description of the Services

2.1 Platform Features

Mochi provides a subscription-based customer relationship management (“CRM”) and artificial intelligence platform designed to assist coaches, consultants, creators and teams with the following:

  • Management of direct messages across supported platforms, including integrations with Meta APIs for Instagram and Facebook and other third-party messaging services.

  • Artificial intelligence-powered features, including AI Setter for automated message generation, response suggestions and AI-powered analytics.

  • Automated messaging capabilities, including scheduled follow-ups, comment automations and triggered direct-message sequences.

  • Voice message generation using third-party text-to-speech services.

  • Tracking of leads, conversations, bookings, payments and client interactions.

  • Data export capabilities for leads and conversation history.

  • Team collaboration features with role-based access controls.

  • YouTube channel integration, video information display, approved link replacement in video descriptions and associated link-click tracking.

  • Integration with third-party services, including calendar scheduling platforms such as Calendly, workflow automation tools such as Zapier, team communication platforms such as Slack, and analytics providers.

2.2 Changes to Features and Integrations

Mochi continuously evolves and may introduce, modify or discontinue features, integrations or services at its sole discretion without prior notice, subject to applicable law.

Access to certain features may be subject to additional terms or eligibility requirements.

3. Subscriptions, Billing, Cancellation and Refunds

Your subscription price, billing period and renewal arrangements are those disclosed when you purchase your subscription.

Fees are due in advance of the applicable subscription period. All payments must be valid, authorized and free from fraudulent activity.

Unless expressly stated otherwise at the time of purchase, your subscription automatically renews for successive billing periods of the same duration until cancelled.

By purchasing a recurring subscription, you authorize Mochi and its payment provider to charge your selected payment method for the applicable subscription fees at each renewal, subject to the disclosures and authorizations required by applicable law.

You are responsible for keeping your billing information accurate and your payment method up to date.

3.2 Tracking Payments Between You and Your Clients

Mochi provides tools to track and record payment information related to your business transactions with your clients.

Mochi does not process payments on your behalf, does not hold funds and is not a payment processor. All payment processing occurs through third-party services, such as Stripe or your own payment systems.

Mochi is not responsible for the accuracy of payment data entered by users, payment disputes, chargebacks or financial transactions between you and your clients.

3.3 Non-Refundable Fees

This policy applies to initial purchases and renewals across all subscription plans, including monthly and prepaid multi-month plans.

Except where required by applicable law, Mochi does not provide refunds or credits for:

Subscription fees pay for access to the Services during the applicable billing period. They are not contingent on your level of use or on achieving any particular booking volume, response rate, revenue, conversion rate or other business outcome.

Nothing in this section excludes a refund, price reduction or other remedy required by applicable law.

You may cancel your subscription at any time using the cancellation method provided for your subscription. If you need assistance, contact hey@themochi.app.

To prevent the next renewal charge, you must cancel before your next renewal date.

Cancellation stops future subscription renewals and ordinarily takes effect at the end of the current paid billing period.

You will continue to have access to the Services until the end of that period, unless earlier suspension or termination is permitted under section 11 or applicable law requires otherwise.

Cancellation does not entitle you to a refund or credit for the remaining portion of the billing period, except where required by applicable law.

Cancellation does not remove payment obligations incurred before it takes effect.

Mochi may change subscription pricing with reasonable advance notice to affected subscribers and any additional notice required by applicable law.

Unless otherwise agreed, a pricing change will apply from a subsequent renewal after the applicable notice period and will not change the price of a subscription period already paid for.

If you do not agree to a pricing change, you may cancel before the renewal at which the new price would apply.

5.1 Available Features

Mochi provides artificial intelligence and automation features designed to assist with customer communication and lead management. These include:

  • AI Setter: AI-generated message suggestions, automated responses and intelligent follow-up sequences configured using your communication style and business context.

  • DM Automations: scheduled and triggered direct-message sequences sent automatically based on configured rules and conditions.

  • Comment Automations: automated replies to social media comments on your posts.

  • AI-Generated Content: automated content creation and delivery based on your settings and training inputs.

  • AI-Powered Analytics: automated analysis of conversations, including lead profiling, sentiment detection, objection identification and behavioral classification.

  • Voice Message Generation: text-to-speech conversion using third-party services, such as ElevenLabs, to create audio messages in customizable voices.
